root_idea.summary: The root has two principal semantic poles: returning from travel, and firmness or dryness leading to closure and restraint.
root_idea.development: The return branch yields words for returning travelers and caravans. The hardness branch yields dry or hardened things, the lock and closing vocabulary, and figurative obstruction.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form قُفْل; the supplied Quranic occurrence is its plural أَقْفَال.

senses.definition: Figurative locks or barriers over hearts, representing an impediment to engaging in an act.
senses.usage_conditions: In أَقْفَالُهَا, the plural lock-image is used metaphorically rather than as a literal reference to hardware; it expresses a barrier affecting the heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lock, especially a device used to secure a door.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV verb describing the act of securing a door by closing it with a lock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Closed off or prevented from undertaking something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن to describe a person barred or impeded from doing or engaging in something.
An idiomatic description of a person whose hands are figuratively closed against giving.
A verbal noun for coming back from travel.
The plural قَوَافِل is also used of lean horses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or caravan traveling together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote a company returning from a journey, a company setting out, or more generally a group traveling together; it is not restricted to returning travelers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry wood or other material that has become dry and hard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is especially associated with dry wood.
Applied to vegetation; also used of a stallion that becomes dry and thin through intense rutting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dry or emaciate someone through fasting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction in which fasting produces dryness or wasting in the person affected.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit explicitly defines the Form IV verb as locking a door.
Pointer-only cross-reference to another entry; it supplies no lexical definition here.
The unit defines قافل as a slender horse.
The unit defines قافلة as a traveling company or caravan and records its return and departure uses.
